method: Single-threaded CPython. Wall time is time.perf_counter_ns and CPU time is time.process_time_ns, both converted to milliseconds. Warmup calls are discarded. The p95 is the nearest-rank statistic at ceil(0.95*n). Handshake time is the sum of the initiator and the responder in one process, with no MQTT hop. DH-style encapsulation includes ephemeral key generation; ML-KEM encapsulation does not. RSA-3072 key generation is capped because it is a commissioning cost, not a per-packet cost.
